subject.title: Slack: Include file attachment metadata in inbound message delivery to agents

question: Should OpenClaw add a shared inbound attachment metadata contract for agents, or keep Slack attachments represented only as placeholders and media path/type fields for now?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the durable fix affects plugin SDK/channel context shape and cross-channel semantics, so automation should not choose the permanent API unilaterally.

options.title: Add Shared Attachment Metadata
options.body: Add a cross-channel InboundAttachments-style field while preserving MediaPath/MediaPaths and placeholder behavior for compatibility.

options.title: Keep Current Contract
options.body: Document that Slack exposes file IDs through placeholders plus downloaded media references and close or defer structured metadata.

options.title: Prototype Slack-Only Metadata
options.body: Add a narrow Slack field first, accepting migration risk if sibling channels need a different shared shape later.

recommendation.title: Add Shared Attachment Metadata
recommendation.body: Add a cross-channel InboundAttachments-style field while preserving MediaPath/MediaPaths and placeholder behavior for compatibility.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and issue discussion connect him to the shared channel/media surfaces that need the API direction decision.
